headline: Hyatt beat Q3 EPS by 65% and raised its 2026 RevPAR outlook; revenue narrowly missed
reasoning: Source: Hyatt's Q3 release, figures on Benzinga Newsdesk at 07:05 ET: 'Q3 Adj. EPS $1.27 Beats $0.77 Estimate, Sales $1.743B Miss $1.747B Estimate'. Benzinga's 08:28 summary: comparable system-wide RevPAR '+7.2% year over year, led by luxury properties'; gross fees '+15.2% to $327 million'; full-year RevPAR growth forecast raised.
What changed: fee income and RevPAR are running well ahead of plan. Revenue is down 2.4% y/y only because of hotels sold in 2025 (an asset-light shift); adjusted EBITDA is +19% excluding them.
Timing: before the open; no session has traded it. Pre-market: Benzinga says the stock 'rose premarket'; IEX shows no prints against the 173.32 close.
objections: Benzinga reports a pre-market rise we cannot see on IEX; part of the beat may already be priced.
